name: Entity Reference Deck
description: Pluggable toolbar actions and erdeck-card chrome for entity reference fields (Entity Browser, Paragraphs).

suggests.drupal/content_moderation: Required to enable entity_reference_deck_moderation (CM-aware card styling).
suggests.drupal/diff: Required to enable entity_reference_deck_diff (revision compare action + modal).
suggests.drupal/entity_browser: Required to enable the entity_reference_deck_eb host submodule.
suggests.drupal/entity_browser_multi: Optional with entity_reference_deck_eb: multi-launcher widget also gets deck chrome when enabled.
suggests.drupal/entity_usage: Required to enable entity_reference_deck_usage (usage action / count surfaces).
suggests.drupal/gin: Recommended with entity_reference_deck_gin for admin theme token remaps.
suggests.drupal/libraries: Optional with entity_reference_deck_preview: Libraries API paths for iframe-resizer.
suggests.drupal/responsive_preview: Optional with entity_reference_deck_preview: device presets for the responsive toolbar.
suggests.drupal/paragraphs: Required to enable the entity_reference_deck_paragraphs host submodule.

project_description: Entity Reference Deck adds pluggable toolbar actions and erdeck-card chrome to entity reference fields. Rather than shipping a new field widget, it layers a shared card builder and a discoverable action/group/meta-item plugin system onto existing host widgets, so editors get moderation status, usage counts, revision diff, live preview and other card actions consistently, regardless of whether the reference is edited through Entity Browser or Paragraphs. The core module (entity_reference_deck) provides three plugin managers (action, group, card meta item), the EntityReferenceDeckCardBuilder / EntityReferenceDeckBuilder services that render the erdeck-card Single Directory Components, a global admin settings form for enabling and re-ordering actions/groups/meta items, and the base classes/attributes/DTOs for the PreviewProvider API. It works standalone (depends only on core Field) and degrades gracefully when the optional feature packages are absent. Host submodules bind the card builder to concrete widgets: Entity Reference Deck EB (Entity Browser FieldWidgetDisplay) and Entity Reference Deck Paragraphs (Paragraphs widget + closed-row chrome). Feature submodules add specific actions/surfaces: Diff (revision compare AJAX modal, requires Diff), Usage (Entity Usage counts, requires Entity Usage), Moderation (Content Moderation-aware card styling) and Paragraphs Library (library-item theme + presentation). The optional Preview submodule renders a live front-end preview of the referenced entity inside each card via a sandboxed iframe and a Lit shell, with hardened persisted/draft-token routes; it does not ship iframe-resizer (install it on the site). The Gin submodule remaps --erdeck-* CSS tokens when the Gin admin theme is active. Configuration is the global settings form plus each field's form-display widget settings; there is no new content type.
